name: CrowdStrike CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Austin-based CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. offers cybersecurity to stop breaches for customers around the world. Its cloud-delivered protection spans endpoints, cloud workloads, identity and data, with threat intelligence, managed security, threat hunting and log management. George Kurtz, Gregg Marston and Dmitri Alperovitch started it on November 7, 2011.
